sources.use_review_basis: Current first-party Mezca tequila-bar page lists named cocktails and EUR numerals in an Italian venue. The cocktail block is repeated in HTML; each named drink is recorded once. Owner homepage Corso Sempione 7 Milano and OSM n3442415711/official static row match name/address/coordinates/owner domain. Owner homepage prints two conflicting phone digits; phone is not used to establish identity. Hold generic starting-price drinks and unpriced choices; no serving or fee inferred.

First-party Para beber page prices five literal grouped soft drinks, five named coffees and 35 named wines/champagnes. Wine producer retained in name; category/serving null because format unspecified. Two dessert-wine 65 numerals held for format ambiguity. Preserve only printed soft-drink sizes; do not split alternatives. Amari/distillati starting-from prices held. EUR from Italian owner context; no fee inferred.
